ValidationRule.description: Requires there to be a MCA product status if the activation date has changed and lead status is Contacted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( DATEVALUE(Activation_Date__c) = TODAY() , ISPICKVAL( Status , "Contacted"), ISBLANK(TEXT( Status_EPP__c )), ISBLANK(TEXT( Status_Lease__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT( Status_MCA__c )), ISBLANK(TEXT( Status_ML__c )))
